shared_output_contract.minimal_editing: Preserve intentional noun phrases and literal formatting; correct only clear errors. Do not infer an agreement error merely from the substring phrase link.
shared_output_contract.no_edit: When the source needs no correction, return exactly The text does not require any adjustments.
shared_output_contract.edited_source: Return the complete minimally corrected source first in a safe text-labeled fence, followed by a truthful Changes list accounting for every actual edit with bold before-and-after quotations. Preserve list markers, emphasis, URL characters, and line breaks.
